details.description: GPT-4o ("omni") is OpenAI's multimodal flagship chat model, accepting text and image input and producing text output, including structured outputs. This catalog entry covers the gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-2024-11-20 snapshots as exposed through OpenAI's fine-tuning API: OpenAI's fine-tuning guide lists gpt-4o-2024-08-06 specifically as supporting vision fine-tuning, letting a user fine-tune the model on both text and image examples. Knowledge cutoff is October 1, 2023.
advantages: OpenAI's fine-tuning guide lists gpt-4o-2024-08-06 as supporting vision fine-tuning, i.e. training on image inputs in addition to text.
OpenAI's model page describes it as the best model for most tasks outside of the o-series reasoning models, combining text and image understanding.
use_cases: Fine-tuning a custom model on image-and-text examples (vision fine-tuning) using the gpt-4o-2024-08-06 snapshot.
General-purpose multimodal chat tasks combining text and image understanding.

notes: No deprecation notice found for gpt-4o-2024-08-06 or gpt-4o-2024-11-20 on OpenAI's deprecations page; an older snapshot, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, is scheduled for shutdown October 23, 2026, but that snapshot is not among this target's URIs. The fine-tuning guide names vision fine-tuning support only for the 2024-08-06 snapshot, not 2024-11-20; could not confirm fine-tuning support for 2024-11-20 specifically.
